about: Nyx Space trajectories for the HPOP reference cases (tests/evidence/nyx/run-nyx.mjs). Samples [t s, x y z m, vx vy vz m/s], GCRF (EME2000 for the EME2000 cases); stm: per sample, the 6x6 orbit STM (row-major) and the Cr and Cd columns per unit Cr*A/m and Cd*A/m, same axes.
